name: NavSafe
subtitle: Early-access iPhone builds of NavSafe.
description: The AltStore source for NavSafe: turn-by-turn navigation that shows the drivers behind you your next move on a rear-window sign. Builds here arrive before the App Store release.

apps.name: NavSafe
apps.subtitle: Show drivers behind you your next turn.
apps.localizedDescription:
NavSafe is turn-by-turn navigation built on Google Maps that can also drive a rear-window LED sign, showing the drivers behind you your next turn and how far away it is.

• Explore the map, search for places and browse nearby petrol, parking, food and more
• Place cards with photos, ratings, opening hours, phone and website
• Driving directions with live traffic, alternative routes, up to three stops, and options to avoid tolls, motorways and ferries
• Turn-by-turn voice guidance with speed limits, a route overview and search along your route
• Saved lists, Home and Work, recent destinations and saved routes
• A live on-screen mirror of the sign on every drive, so you can try NavSafe without any hardware
• Light and dark themes that follow your iPhone

About this build: this is an early-access build shared through AltStore while the App Store version is in review. CarPlay and Sign in with Apple aren't available here, so sign in with your email address instead. NavSafe needs your location to navigate; choose "Always" if you want the sign to keep working with the screen off.

versions.localizedDescription:
A cleaner, more consistent NavSafe, now in miles.

• Distances now show in miles and yards by default. You can switch to kilometres in Settings
• Driving: Google's extra buttons are gone. Pan the map and a Re-centre button brings you back. Traffic warnings still show
• Opening Settings during a drive no longer ends the drive, and nothing closes it without asking "End this drive?"
• A light map now stays light at night during a drive, matching the rest of the app
• The phone's sign preview shows a standby dash instead of a black box between turns
• The You tab is simpler: one place to sign in, and the old Account & settings page has been removed
• Trip details now give a plain summary: when, how long, how it ended, and what the sign showed
• Lists: add places straight from search, and undo if you remove one by mistake
• Tidier Explore, place details and route preview, a step-by-step sign setup, and clearer wording throughout

Fixes directions starting from an old position.

• Explore and the route preview now keep following your location, so a route always starts where you are now, not where the map last found you
• Opening directions from the You tab, or straight after returning to the app, waits a moment to confirm your position before routing
• The route preview shows your live location dot

First AltStore release of the redesigned NavSafe.

• New Explore map with category search and full place cards: photos, ratings, opening hours, phone and website
• New You tab: saved lists, Home and Work, recent destinations, trips and saved routes
• In-drive search along your route, route overview and steps, and sound controls
• A live mirror of the rear sign during navigation
• Light and dark themes that follow your iPhone

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: NavSafe connects to your CoolLEDUX sign over Bluetooth to show the upcoming turn and distance.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: NavSafe connects to your CoolLEDUX sign over Bluetooth to show the upcoming turn and distance.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: NavSafe connects to your rear-window sign over your local Wi-Fi network to show the upcoming turn and distance.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: NavSafe keeps using your location in the background so the rear-window sign keeps showing the upcoming turn while you drive with the screen off.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NavSafe uses your location to provide turn-by-turn navigation and to drive the rear-window sign.
